content.user_title: Build n8n Workflows with MCP Tools
content.value_statement: n8n users need reliable guidance when choosing MCP tools and node type formats. This skill explains tool selection, validation, workflow updates, and template deployment.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use n8n MCP tools for node search, validation, workflow editing, templates, and documentation.
Shows correct nodeType formats for search, validation, and workflow creation tools.
Provides validation profiles, detail levels, and tool modes for reliable n8n configuration checks.
Guides template search, template inspection, and deployment through n8n-mcp tools.
Documents iterative workflow creation, partial updates, validation, and activation patterns.
limitations: It is a guide only; it does not include executable scripts or direct n8n API code.
It assumes the n8n-mcp server and required MCP tools are already available.
Workflow write tools require a configured n8n API URL and API key.
Referenced detailed guide files are not included in this skill package.

use_cases.title: Select n8n Nodes
use_cases.description: Find the correct node, inspect supported operations, and request documentation before building a workflow.

use_cases.title: Validate Workflow Changes
use_cases.description: Check node configurations and workflow structure before activating or updating production automations.

use_cases.title: Guide AI Tool Use
use_cases.description: Help Claude, Codex, or Claude Code choose the right n8n MCP tool and parameter format.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Node
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the n8n MCP tools guide to find a node for my task. Show which tool to call first and what to inspect next.

prompt_templates.title: Validate a Configuration
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my n8n node configuration with the correct validation mode and profile. Explain errors, warnings, and the next fix.

prompt_templates.title: Iterate a Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan an iterative n8n workflow build using partial updates. Include validation checkpoints and the correct node type formats.

prompt_templates.title: Deploy a Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Find a suitable n8n template, inspect its structure, and prepare a deployment plan with credential and validation checks.

output_examples.input: Find a node for sending a Slack message.
output: Start with node search using the Slack keyword.
Inspect the Slack node with standard detail before asking for full schema.
Validate the chosen operation before adding it to a workflow.

output_examples.output: The skill recommends validating node configurations first, then validating the full workflow, then activating only after errors are resolved.

output_examples.input: Deploy a webhook to Slack template.
output_examples.output: The skill guides template search, structure inspection, required credential review, automatic fixes, and final workflow validation.

best_practices: Use standard detail level first, then request full schemas only when needed.
Validate each important change before activation or deployment.
Keep node type formats aligned with the target tool category.
anti_patterns: Using workflow node type prefixes with search or validation tools.
Building and activating a complete workflow without intermediate validation.
Requesting full node schemas by default for every task.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps agents choose and use n8n-mcp tools for search, validation, workflow editing, templates, and documentation.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands?
faq.answer: No. The package contains Markdown guidance and examples, not executable scripts.

faq.question: Does it need n8n credentials?
faq.answer: Only workflow write and deployment tools need an n8n API URL and API key configured in the MCP server.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The listing supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it help deploy templates?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains template search, template inspection, deployment options, and validation steps.

faq.question: What should I verify before production use?
faq.answer: Validate node configurations, validate the full workflow, confirm credentials, and activate only after resolving errors.
